scope: 129 recovered benchmark and service-probe rows, not a complete history of every experiment. Public metrics only; private paths, endpoints, raw prompts and case records omitted.

definitions.wall_s: Sum of recorded client request elapsed times, excluding between-request/startup delays.
definitions.rates: Server-reported tokens/sec; distribution over requests, not aggregate token/time throughput.
definitions.quality: Original pinned public123 and frozen24 scorers. Do not compare percentages across suites.
definitions.p95: Nearest rank, unweighted per recorded case.
definitions.missing: Null/recorded-case counts denote absent telemetry; missing fields are not evidence of zero failures/retries/truncations.
